title: Trump lashes out at 'fake news' and jokes about 2028 presidential run in press gala do-over
summary: US President Donald Trump delivered an at-times rambling speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner Friday, three months after an alleged assassination attempt brought the annual event to an abrupt halt. Trump notably joked about running for a third presidential term in 2028, which is barred under the US Constitution.
